about: Mutate Silf header, classes, FSM and bytecode; strict-read each variant then execute every accepted program with bounded work. Four embedded original/real fonts. Added conditional-collision font on selector high bit 128; original 64 seed recipes keep their meaning. Bit32 on the new high-bit recipes selects the rule-free feature pass.
